tvShow.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
tvShow.overview: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

episodes.name: I Accidentally Vaporize My Pre-Algebra Teacher
episodes.overview: Expelled from school, Percy Jackson unravels who he is, confronting a world of gods and monsters.

episodes.name: I Become Supreme Lord of the Bathroom
episodes.overview: Percy finds his place at Camp Half Blood, where he learns just how special his origins may be.

episodes.name: We Visit the Garden Gnome Emporium
episodes.overview: Percy sets off on the quest to return Zeus' master bolt and stop a war between the gods.

episodes.name: I Plunge to My Death
episodes.overview: Our heroes search for a refuge in St Louis, and come face to face with the mother of all monsters.

episodes.name: A God Buys Us Cheeseburgers
episodes.overview: The quest deepens as Percy, Annabeth, and Grover are tasked with a favor from a fearsome opponent.

episodes.name: We Take a Zebra to Vegas
episodes.overview: Percy, Annabeth, and Grover must resist the alluring draw of a casino that feels outside of time.

episodes.name: We Find Out the Truth, Sort Of
episodes.overview: Our heroes journey across the Underworld, and bargain for their safety with the god of the dead.

episodes.name: The Prophecy Comes True
episodes.overview: Mount Olympus beckons... and Percy must face his greatest battle yet.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Percy Jackson, the demigod son of Poseidon, is accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. Percy embarks on an adventure with his friends Annabeth Chase and Grover Underwood to uncover the truth and rescue his mother from the Underworld.

episodes.name: I Play Dodgeball with Cannibals
episodes.overview: Percy, Annabeth, and Tyson race to defend Camp Half-Blood from dangerous forces.

episodes.name: Demon Pigeons Attack
episodes.overview: Percy and Annabeth contend with a new activities director as they try to locate Grover.

episodes.name: We Board the Princess Andromeda
episodes.overview: Aboard a cruise ship, our heroes struggle to differentiate friend from foe.

episodes.name: Clarisse Blows Up Everything
episodes.overview: Quests collide as our crew voyages into the perilous Sea of Monsters.

episodes.name: We Check In to C.C.'s Spa & Resort
episodes.overview: Percy and Annabeth must confront their flaws at a resort sanctuary.

episodes.name: Nobody Gets the Fleece
episodes.overview: Percy and Annabeth go undercover on an island to rescue their friends.

episodes.name: I Go Down with the Ship
episodes.overview: With a friend in danger, our heroes must risk everything to continue their quest.

episodes.name: The Fleece Works Its Magic Too Well
episodes.overview: Our heroes race to save camp as Luke and Kronos’ army advances.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After Camp Half-Blood's protective border is breached, Percy Jackson embarks on an epic odyssey into the Sea of Monsters in search of his best friend, the satyr Grover Underwood, and the one thing that may save the camp — the legendary Golden Fleece. Aided by demigods Annabeth Chase and Clarisse La Rue, along with his cyclops half-brother Tyson, Percy's survival becomes the key to preventing Luke and the Titan Kronos from bringing down Camp Half-Blood — and, ultimately, Olympus.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The stakes are higher than ever before as Percy is faced with the sudden disappearance of Annabeth and the impending Great Prophecy provided by the Oracle of Delphi, dictating the fate of Olympus. As foretold by the Oracle of Delphi, one demigod child of the "Big Three" is fated to raise Olympus to new heights or bring it crashing into ruin, with their own life hanging in the balance.

reviews.author: Ruairí
reviews.content: A promising adaptation of a franchise that was let down movie-wise. The bold casting choices make for interesting dynamics and Jason Mantzoukas (Mr. D/Dionysus) does not disappoint! This series is a surprising fresh start from Disney.

reviews.author: TkA
reviews.content:
**Bad.**

What a disappointing start. No desire to watch this anymore. It's pretty clear that this series is on par with the train wrecks disney has been doling out for the last decade. Another outing in a long line of wastes of time where they dropped the ball on casting, realism, pumped up cringe, or ditching the story or changing it to fill a checklist.

Hope is now lost for this series too. But you can now set your watch and expect disney will keep doling out disasters. The track record is clear after what they've done to other things, like Doctor Who, Star Wars, etc. Disney was once great, but it's now in the gutter.

Like another user said, this makes the movies looks good.
